## Recall · Excel and Word

a) Huda needs the total of 24 sales for the report. Where does she make it?
b) Which style does a main heading of a report get?
c) Which paste option gives a Word table in the look of the report?

::: {.answer}
a) in Excel, with a SUM formula
b) Heading 1
c) Use Destination Styles
:::

## Recall · Slides from the report

a) How many points should a slide have?
b) What does a Heading 1 line become with Slides from Outline?
c) What does a Normal line become?

::: {.answer}
a) 3 to 5 short points
b) a slide title
c) nothing on the slides
:::

{{< sim file="../../week-14/sims/office-relay.html" poster="../../week-14/sims/office-relay.png" title="Office Relay: six jobs in three apps" kind="game" task="**Show:** the first round, the total of 24 sales, and the round of the AI draft with 50 %. **Ask:** which app does the numbers, and what do you do with an AI number?" answer="Excel does the numbers with a SUM formula, and every AI number is checked in Excel before it is used." >}}

## Summary

- Excel makes the numbers: a SUM formula and a chart with a real title.
- Use Destination Styles pastes a table in the look of the Word report.
- A pasted table is a copy: it does not follow Excel.
- Heading 1 lines become slide titles, and Heading 2 lines become bullets.
- Every AI number is checked with the data before it goes on a slide.
